scripts.setup: uv venv .venv --python 3.13 && uv pip install --prerelease=allow -r requirements.txt
scripts.test:infra:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && echo 'Test infra is ready'
scripts.test:ci: pnpm test:infra:up && pnpm test && pnpm test:unit; EXIT_CODE=$?; pnpm test:infra:down; exit $EXIT_CODE
